rationale.en: The measure does not create a tax. The Analyst estimates the $10 billion General Fund-repaid portion would cost the state General Fund $500 million to $600 million a year for about 25 years, and that $10 billion bond would cost about 15 percent more than paying up front. The $1.25 billion veterans bond is repaid by veterans' loan payments and has no direct state cost. The Analyst does not assess accountability or reporting provisions.
